task_completion.description: Create at least 4 rooms using at least 4 partition walls and 3 doors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing a floor plan divided into at least 4 distinct enclosed or semi-enclosed areas with visible wall segments and door icons/swings.

task_completion.description: Apply distinct floor colors or textures to at least 2 rooms.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual difference in floor shading, color, or pattern between at least two of the defined room areas.

task_completion.description: Place at least 12 high-density storage items (bookcases, shelves, or cabinets) in the Secure Vault.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A cluster of at least 12 storage-type icons or 3D models located within the designated Vault zone.

task_completion.description: Place at least 7 desks/tables and 10 chairs across the Reading Room and staff areas.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Countable desk/table objects (min 7) and chair objects (min 10) distributed in the non-vault rooms.

task_completion.description: Place at least 1 sink in the Conservation Lab.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A sink fixture or plumbing icon located within the room designated as the Conservation Lab.

task_completion.description: Document aisle widths in the Vault using at least 2 dimension lines.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At least two linear dimension annotations (arrows with numerical values) measuring the space between storage units in the Vault.

task_completion.description: The completed layout must contain at least 45 total furniture items.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The overall density of the plan should reflect a high volume of items; if the software has an object list or property panel, it should show a count >= 45.
The agent clicking a 'Save' icon, selecting 'File > Save', or a 'File Saved' notification appearing in the UI.

integrity.description: The agent used the design software GUI rather than just terminal scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with menus, dragging furniture, or drawing walls within the application interface.

integrity.description: The layout was built incrementally rather than appearing instantly.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequence of screenshots showing the progression from an empty shell to a furnished archive.

integrity.description: The agent placed actual furniture objects rather than just text labels to meet counts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual presence of 3D models or 2D CAD blocks representing desks, chairs, and shelves.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must start with 'archive_shell_starter.sh'. To pass, the final design must have: 4+ rooms, 4+ new walls, 3+ doors, 2+ rooms with unique floor colors, 12+ storage units in the vault, 7+ desks and 10+ chairs in other areas, 1+ sink in the lab, 2+ dimension lines in the vault, and a total furniture count of at least 45 items.
